title: Pathfinder Skill Tree
description: A custom Pufferfish Skill Tree featuring 20 Levels, Attribute choices and a steep xp curve
body:
# Pathfinder Skill Tree

Pathfinder inspired Skill Tree

![Skill Tree Image](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/ee8f771c41b5bff8c1d0d768167e46e84133e38a.png)

### Features:
- 20 Levels
- Extremely steep xp curve, maxing out your character takes dedication
- Attribute choices every 4 levels and on level 1
- Every levelup is a substancial power increase

### Requires:
- Pufferfish Skills & Attributes
- Iron's Spellbooks
